facts.fact: The health ministry's national health policy states that the health information system is organised over the three levels of the pyramid but does not work effectively: the information exists in health facilities, but the system cannot yet collect and transcribe it through a computerised system, only some programmes and projects doing so in a targeted, siloed way.

systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population
systems.tiers: organised over the central, intermediate (departmental) and peripheral (health district) levels; not computerised as of 2018

note: Nothing on electronic patient records. The policy gives the facility denominators of 2018: 597 first-contact public facilities, of which 334 centres de santé intégrés and 232 health posts; 31 functional district (base) hospitals for 52 health districts; 7 to 8 general hospitals.
